# M2-0: Carried M1 cleanup

- Milestone: M2
- Branch / worktree: `t/M2-0`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M2-0`
- Depends on: none
- Touches (exclusive while running): cmd/scheduler.go (comment only), store/, sync/
- Plan refs: §2 `plan_scan`, N3. Each item below was checked against main at 219caf4.
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: yes (steps below)

## Goal
Close three lows carried from M1 before M2 builds on these packages: a failed archived scan no longer destroys good scan
results, the live database files are private, and the scheduler comment matches the code.

## Scope
1. `sync/mirror.go` `ScanDiscretionary`: a plan that fails the scan currently gets `has_discretionary=false` and replaces
   the prior row, because `ReplacePlanScans` deletes the whole table. A failed plan must keep its previous
   `has_discretionary` and `scanned_at` (the last successful scan), with the new `scan_error` set. A plan with no prior
   row stays false. Plans no longer listed still disappear.
2. `sync.ScanError`: add `Unwrap() []error` so `errors.Is(err, ynab.ErrBudgetExhausted)` and `ErrRateLimited` work through
   it. Keep the redaction guarantee: `Error()` and anything reachable through `Unwrap` must carry no ids.
3. `store/`: database files are 0600. New files are created 0600. Opening an existing database tightens the main file and
   any existing `-wal` and `-shm` to 0600, so hoid's current 0644 files get fixed by the deploy. Skip `:memory:`. A failed
   chmod is an open error. Also confirm the `VACUUM INTO` temp file in `backup/` is not world-readable; report what you
   find in Result and fix it only if it's a one-line change in `backup/`.
4. `cmd/scheduler.go` `Scheduler` doc comment: it says any tick due during a job is dropped. Actually a job drops only its
   own tick, and other jobs' ticks run right after (see `drain` and CLAUDE.md). Comment change only.

## Out of scope
- Any behaviour change to the scheduler, or to import. `IMPORT_ENABLED` stays exactly as it is.
- `CLAUDE.md`: its Safety section already names `HEALTHCHECK_PING_URL`, so that carried low is closed.
- Other M1 lows (edit_window_closed, shutdown wait).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: good scan, then a scan where one plan fails with `ErrBudgetExhausted`: that plan's row keeps
      `has_discretionary=true` and its old `scanned_at`, and `scan_error` is set; other plans update normally.
- [ ] Test: `errors.Is(scanErr, ynab.ErrBudgetExhausted)` is true; the error text and unwrapped errors contain no UUID.
- [ ] Test: new DB file is 0600. An existing DB, `-wal` and `-shm` at 0644 are all 0600 after open, and stay 0600 after
      writes and after a reopen.
- [ ] `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` green

## Deploy steps / smoke check
sup, after merge: `./deploy/deploy.sh` as its own command, then
`ssh hoid 'docker exec finbot-finbot-1 sh -c "stat -c \"%a %n\" /data/finbot.db*"; docker exec finbot-finbot-1 finbot health'`
Expect 600 on every file, health exit 0, and the existing Slack status message edited rather than re-posted.

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `store/migrations/0004_plan_scan_keep_verdict.sql` (new): rebuilds `plan_scan` so a row can hold a verdict and an error
    together. The old CHECK forbade it. A success with no verdict is still refused; existing rows are kept.
  - `store/planscan.go`: `ReplacePlanScans` now prunes unlisted plans and upserts. A failed row updates only `name` and
    `scan_error`, and a success clears the error.
  - `sync/mirror.go`: a `PlanScanFailure` keeps its cause privately. `ScanError.Unwrap() []error` returns `scanCause`
    values with redacted text that match the cause through `errors.Is`, with no `Unwrap` of their own.
  - `store/store.go`: `makePrivate` runs at the start of `Open`. It creates the main file 0600 and tightens existing main,
    `-wal` and `-shm` to 0600. A chmod failure fails the open. `:memory:` is skipped.
  - `cmd/scheduler.go`: `Scheduler` doc comment corrected, comment only.
- Acceptance:
  - Good scan, then one plan fails with `ErrBudgetExhausted`: pass, `go test ./sync -run TestScanDiscretionary_FailureKeepsLastGoodScan`.
    Also covers no prior row staying false and unlisted plans disappearing. Repeat failures and clearing the error:
    `go test ./store -run TestPlanScansFailureKeepsLastGoodVerdict`.
  - `errors.Is` true, no UUID in the text or anything unwrapped: pass, `go test ./sync -run TestScanError_MatchesCausesWithoutLeakingIDs`.
  - New DB 0600; existing DB, `-wal`, `-shm` at 0644 become 0600 and stay so after writes and a reopen: pass,
    `go test ./store -run 'TestOpenNewDatabaseIsPrivate|TestOpenTightensExistingDatabase'`. Failed chmod is an open error:
    `TestOpenFailsIfFilesCantBeTightened`. Migration on existing rows: `TestPlanScanMigrationKeepsRows`.
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...`: pass.
  - Deploy smoke check: not run, it's sup's step after merge.
- `VACUUM INTO` temp file: not world-readable in practice, no fix needed. Measured with a throwaway test: the snapshot file
  itself is 0644, but it sits in the `os.MkdirTemp` directory (0700) that `backup.Run` creates and removes, so other users
  can't reach it.
- Deviations from brief:
  - Added a migration, which the brief didn't list, because the 0002 CHECK makes item 1 impossible without one.
  - A plan that has never scanned successfully stores `has_discretionary` NULL (reads as false) and keeps the time of its
    first failed attempt in `scanned_at`, because the column is NOT NULL.
- Follow-ups for backlog:
  - **M2-1a must renumber:** its brief names `0004_oauth`, and this task now takes 0004, so it becomes `0005_oauth`. A
    duplicate version fails at load. Its `schema_migrations` count assertions in `store/store_test.go` will move too.
  - `ScanDiscretionary`'s returned list is unchanged: a failed plan is left out even if its stored verdict is true, so
    `finbot sync --archived` skips that plan for that run. Only `plan_scan` retains the verdict.
- Deploy risk for sup: if any file in `/data` isn't owned by uid 10001, chmod fails, `finbot` won't start, and the deploy's
  health wait fails. I didn't check ownership on hoid because the brief lists no such step.
- Docs follow-ups:
  - `CLAUDE.md` store role: add `0004_plan_scan_keep_verdict` to the migrations list and say database files are kept 0600.
  - `docs/plan/architecture.md:48`: "a scan replaces the whole table" should say a failed plan keeps its last good
    `has_discretionary` and `scanned_at`, and unlisted plans are dropped.
